text:
IncidentBot: :rotating_light: ALERT: GPU pool 'pool-east-3' at 94% util, queue depth increasing rapidly. Trigger: prefill amplification observed after model v34 rollout. Autoscaler attempted scale but failed to allocate within max burst window.

Alice (oncall): seeing this, thanks. linking metrics and logs: https://console.redwood/metrics/pool-east-3/heatmap

Ben (infra): looking. autoscaler logs show repeated scale attempts hit quota error from cloud provider and then the controller lock timed out. snippet: 
```
ERROR autoscaler: allocate: quota_exceeded for g4dn.xlarge
WARN autoscaler: leader-lock timeout acquiring pool-lock
```

Charu (sre): CPU on scheduler nodes is fine but GPU warmup prefill jobs are spawning a ton of KV cache entries — memory blowup and opaque queueing. Requests are piling with prefix length ~12000 tokens on some requests.

Alice (oncall): customer-facing impact? Erin?

Erin (support): some customers seeing degraded latency and 429s for generation endpoints. I have two customers who reported timeouts on conversational endpoints. CS ticket numbers: #CS-4411, #CS-4415. Frank on it.

Frank (cs): notified both customers and offered workaround to pin to hosted model v33 for now. They want ETA.

Ben (infra): immediate mitigations I can try: 
- scale down the new rollout traffic % to 0 (canary pause)
- temporarily raise autoscaler max instances while we throttle prefills
- disable background prefill warmups for v34

Alice (oncall): prioritize pause rollout + disable prefill. Who can flip those?

DeployBot: Automated: rollout v34 -> traffic cutoff request received by deploy API. Waiting for human confirmation.

Charu (sre): Commands to pause canary: 
```bash
# set rollout to 0% for v34
redwood deploy update --model v34 --traffic 0
# disable prefill worker loop
kubectl -n inference patch cm prefill-config --type merge -p '{"data":{"enabled":"false"}}'
```

Ben (infra): I'll queue the autoscaler bump but need approval from ops budget lead (we have burst cap). Proposed: temporary raise max_instances from 80 -> 110 for pool-east-3 for 1 hour.

Alice (oncall): Approve short burst (60 minutes) if it gets us to stable. Authorize now.

Ben (infra): doing it. 
```bash
# backend call (infra) - executed
PATCH /api/v1/pools/pool-east-3 {"max_instances":110, "burst_ttl_minutes":60}
```

IncidentBot: Scaling request accepted by cloud provider; provisioning delayed ~4m per node.

Charu (sre): while nodes spin up, we need to reduce pressure from KV cache. Proposed two-step: 1) evict oldest KV namespaces for v34 prefill; 2) throttle per-tenant token window for heavy contexts.

Ben (infra): Eviction command below. Note this will cause some cold cache penalties but prevents OOMs.
```bash
# evict v34 prefill namespace
redwood kvcache evict --namespace v34-prefill --max-age 1m
```

Alice (oncall): go ahead with eviction. Monitor error rates.

Erin (support): updating customers: "We've paused the v34 rollout and applied mitigations to stabilize capacity. We'll follow up in 30m with progress."

Frank (cs): sending note now.

Charu (sre): observed immediate drop in enqueue rate after prefill disable and eviction. Queue depth falling from ~12k -> ~3.2k in 7m. Latency improved on partial routes.

Ben (infra): new nodes are healthy and registering. Autoscaler reports +28 GPUs added, pool now at 78% util.

Alice (oncall): good. Checklist: 
- rollout paused: done
- prefill disabled: done
- kvcache eviction: done
- autoscaler temporary bump: done
- customers notified: done

Charu (sre): root cause preliminary hypothesis: tokenizer change in v34 increased effective context tokens per request for prefill logic, causing a prefill fanout multiplier x3 for long conversations. KV prefill workers spawned heavier-than-expected entries. The prefill worker didn't honor new size estimator so we ended up with amplification.

Ben (infra): additionally autoscaler leader-lock implementation struggled because many allocation attempts happened simultaneously causing API quota backoffs -> controller lock contention. Fix paths: exponential backoff + leader election jitter.

Alice (oncall): next steps before handoff to Dana (night-oncall) in 30m: 
1) revert tokenizer change in prefill estimator (hotfix branch prepared by Dana?).
2) Add short-term rate limit on prefill jobs per model.
3) Postmortem and rollout gating on token-estimate tests.

Dana (night-oncall): I can pick up the hotfix if someone pushes the branch. Leaving in 30m for handoff. Please include a short summary and current metrics snapshot.

Charu (sre): pushing a minimal hotfix to prefill estimator now (branch: fix/prefill-estimator-v34). It's a non-model build change; safe to patch.

DeployBot: Automated: patch build queued for rollout to inference workers (non-volatile).

Ben (infra): I've also opened an infra ticket to add leader-lock jitter: INFRA-1896.

Alice (oncall): Erin/Frank — any customers still impacted?

Erin (support): two customers still reporting intermittent 429s but much better. I'll keep them on a watchlist.

Frank (cs): CS following up with pinned v33 workaround. customers prefer to wait for stable v34 and re-evaluate.

Dana (night-oncall): taking this over. Summary for handoff: 
- root cause: prefill amplification after v34 tokenizer change causing kv growth + long-context prefill fanout
- immediate mitigations applied: pause rollout, disable prefill, evict v34 kvcache ns, temporary autoscaler bump + nodes added
- customer impact: degraded latency and 429s for small subset (2 reported tickets), no data leakage, no persistent errors beyond 429/timeouts
- outstanding: merge hotfix, add prefill rate limiter, infra leader-lock jitter, postmortem with rollout gates

Alice (oncall): thanks Dana. I'm heading out. If the queue depth rises above 5k again or GPU util > 90% ping oncall-urgent.

IncidentBot: NOTE: follow-up actions assigned: CH-112 (hotfix deploy), INFRA-1896 (leader-lock jitter), PM-742 (postmortem).

Dana (night-oncall): will monitor metrics and post updates. leaving this thread as the single source of truth.

Charu (sre): quick log snippets for postmortem: 
```
prefill_controller.go: prefill_multiplier=3.4, estimated_entries=4234 -> spawned_jobs=14500
autoscaler.go: allocation_attempts=67, quota_errors=60, leader_lock_wait=28s
```

Erin (support): I’ll keep CS notes and will update customers when v34 is back with a safe ETA.

Frank (cs): thanks all.

Dana (night-oncall): closing loop: current state as of last check (ts 5301234620): queue depth 2.9k, pool util 72%, kvcache size for v34 reduced by 82%. Continuing to watch."
